versos.grego: Ἀλήθειαν λέγω ἐν Χριστῷ, οὐ ψεύδομαι, συνμαρτυρούσης μοι τῆς συνειδήσεώς μου ἐν Πνεύματι Ἁγίῳ,

controles.web: I tell the truth in Christ. I am not lying, my conscience testifying with me in the Holy Spirit,
controles.kjv: I say the truth in Christ, I lie not, my conscience also bearing me witness in the Holy Ghost,
controles.livre: Digo a verdade em Cristo, não minto, e minha consciência dá testemunho comigo pelo Espírito Santo,

versos.grego: ὅτι λύπη μοί ἐστιν μεγάλη καὶ ἀδιάλειπτος ὀδύνη τῇ καρδίᾳ μου.

controles.web: that I have great sorrow and unceasing pain in my heart.
controles.kjv: That I have great heaviness and continual sorrow in my heart.
controles.livre: de que tenho grande tristeza e contínuo tormento em meu coração.

versos.grego: ηὐχόμην γὰρ ἀνάθεμα εἶναι αὐτὸς ἐγὼ ἀπὸ τοῦ Χριστοῦ ὑπὲρ τῶν ἀδελφῶν μου τῶν συγγενῶν μου κατὰ σάρκα,

controles.web: For I could wish that I myself were accursed from Christ for my brothers’ sake, my relatives according to the flesh,
controles.kjv: For I could wish that myself were accursed from Christ for my brethren, my kinsmen according to the flesh:
controles.livre: Porque desejaria eu mesmo ser separado de Cristo em proveito dos meus irmãos, que são meus parentes segundo a carne;

versos.grego: οἵτινές εἰσιν Ἰσραηλεῖται, ὧν ἡ υἱοθεσία καὶ ἡ δόξα καὶ αἱ διαθῆκαι καὶ ἡ νομοθεσία καὶ ἡ λατρεία καὶ αἱ ἐπαγγελίαι,

controles.web: who are Israelites; whose is the adoption, the glory, the covenants, the giving of the law, the service, and the promises;
controles.kjv: Who are Israelites; to whom pertaineth the adoption, and the glory, and the covenants, and the giving of the law, and the service of God, and the promises;
controles.livre: que são israelitas, e a quem pertencem a adoção como filhos, a glória, os pactos, a Lei, o culto, e as promessas;

versos.grego: ὧν οἱ πατέρες, καὶ ἐξ ὧν ὁ Χριστὸς τὸ κατὰ σάρκα, ὁ ὢν ἐπὶ πάντων Θεὸς εὐλογητὸς εἰς τοὺς αἰῶνας, ἀμήν.

controles.web: of whom are the fathers, and from whom is Christ as concerning the flesh, who is over all, God, blessed forever. Amen.
controles.kjv: Whose are the fathers, and of whom as concerning the flesh Christ came, who is over all, God blessed for ever. Amen.
controles.livre: deles são os patriarcas, e deles, quanto à carne, é Cristo, que é sobre todos, Deus bendito eternamente, Amém!

versos.grego: Οὐχ οἷον δὲ ὅτι ἐκπέπτωκεν ὁ λόγος τοῦ Θεοῦ. οὐ γὰρ πάντες οἱ ἐξ Ἰσραήλ, οὗτοι Ἰσραήλ·

controles.web: But it is not as though the word of God has come to nothing. For they are not all Israel, that are of Israel.
controles.kjv: Not as though the word of God hath taken none effect. For they are not all Israel, which are of Israel:
controles.livre: Não que a palavra de Deus tenha falhado; porque nem todos os que são de Israel são verdadeiros israelitas.

versos.grego: οὐδ’ ὅτι εἰσὶν σπέρμα Ἀβραάμ, πάντες τέκνα, ἀλλ’ Ἐν Ἰσαὰκ κληθήσεταί σοι σπέρμα.

controles.web: Neither, because they are Abraham’s seed, are they all children. But, “In Isaac will your seed be called.”
controles.kjv: Neither, because they are the seed of Abraham, are they all children: but, In Isaac shall thy seed be called.
controles.livre: Nem por serem descendentes de Abraão são todos filhos, mas: “Em Isaque será chamada a tua descendência”.

versos.grego: τοῦτ’ ἔστιν, οὐ τὰ τέκνα τῆς σαρκὸς ταῦτα τέκνα τοῦ Θεοῦ, ἀλλὰ τὰ τέκνα τῆς ἐπαγγελίας λογίζεται εἰς σπέρμα.

controles.web: That is, it is not the children of the flesh who are children of God, but the children of the promise are counted as a seed.
controles.kjv: That is, They which are the children of the flesh, these are not the children of God: but the children of the promise are counted for the seed.
controles.livre: Isto é, não são os filhos da carne que são os filhos de Deus; mas sim os filhos da promessa que são contados como descendência.

versos.grego: ἐπαγγελίας γὰρ ὁ λόγος οὗτος Κατὰ τὸν καιρὸν τοῦτον ἐλεύσομαι καὶ ἔσται τῇ Σάρρᾳ υἱός.

controles.web: For this is a word of promise, “At the appointed time I will come, and Sarah will have a son.”
controles.kjv: For this is the word of promise, At this time will I come, and Sara shall have a son.
controles.livre: Pois esta é a palavra da promessa: Aproximadamente a este tempo  virei, e Sara terá um filho.

versos.grego: οὐ μόνον δέ, ἀλλὰ καὶ Ῥεβέκκα ἐξ ἑνὸς κοίτην ἔχουσα, Ἰσαὰκ τοῦ πατρὸς ἡμῶν·

controles.web: Not only so, but Rebekah also conceived by one, by our father Isaac.
controles.kjv: And not only this; but when Rebecca also had conceived by one, even by our father Isaac;
controles.livre: E não somente isso, mas também Rebeca, quando esteve grávida por intermédio de um só, Isaque, nosso ancestral

versos.grego: μήπω γὰρ γεννηθέντων μηδὲ πραξάντων τι ἀγαθὸν ἢ φαῦλον, ἵνα ἡ κατ’ ἐκλογὴν πρόθεσις τοῦ Θεοῦ μένῃ,

controles.web: For being not yet born, neither having done anything good or bad, that the purpose of God according to election might stand, not of works, but of him who calls,
controles.kjv: (For the children being not yet born, neither having done any good or evil, that the purpose of God according to election might stand, not of works, but of him that calleth;)
controles.livre: (pois, como não eram ainda nascidos, não haviam feito bem ou mal, para que o propósito de Deus, segundo a escolha, continuasse; não pelas obras, mas por causa daquele que chama),

versos.grego: οὐκ ἐξ ἔργων ἀλλ’ ἐκ τοῦ καλοῦντος, ἐρρέθη αὐτῇ ὅτι Ὁ μείζων δουλεύσει τῷ ἐλάσσονι·

controles.web: it was said to her, “The elder will serve the younger.”
controles.kjv: It was said unto her, The elder shall serve the younger.
controles.livre: foi dito a ela: O mais velho servirá o mais jovem;

versos.grego: καθάπερ γέγραπται Τὸν Ἰακὼβ ἠγάπησα, τὸν δὲ Ἠσαῦ ἐμίσησα.

controles.web: Even as it is written, “Jacob I loved, but Esau I hated.”
controles.kjv: As it is written, Jacob have I loved, but Esau have I hated.
controles.livre: como está escrito: “Amei Jacó, mas odiei Esaú”.

versos.grego: Τί οὖν ἐροῦμεν; μὴ ἀδικία παρὰ τῷ θεῷ; μὴ γένοιτο.

controles.web: What shall we say then? Is there unrighteousness with God? May it never be!
controles.kjv: What shall we say then? Is there unrighteousness with God? God forbid.
controles.livre: Que diremos, então? Que há injustiça da parte de Deus? De maneira nenhuma!

versos.grego: τῷ Μωϋσεῖ γὰρ λέγει Ἐλεήσω ὃν ἂν ἐλεῶ, καὶ οἰκτειρήσω ὃν ἂν οἰκτείρω.

controles.web: For he said to Moses, “I will have mercy on whom I have mercy, and I will have compassion on whom I have compassion.”
controles.kjv: For he saith to Moses, I will have mercy on whom I will have mercy, and I will have compassion on whom I will have compassion.
controles.livre: Pois ele diz a Moisés: “Terei misericórdia de quem eu tiver misericórdia, e me compadecerei de quem eu me compadecer”.

versos.grego: ἄρα οὖν οὐ τοῦ θέλοντος οὐδὲ τοῦ τρέχοντος, ἀλλὰ τοῦ ἐλεῶντος Θεοῦ.

controles.web: So then it is not of him who wills, nor of him who runs, but of God who has mercy.
controles.kjv: So then it is not of him that willeth, nor of him that runneth, but of God that sheweth mercy.
controles.livre: Portanto, não depende daquele que quer, nem daquele que se esforça,  mas sim, de Deus, que se compadece.

versos.grego: λέγει γὰρ ἡ γραφὴ τῷ Φαραὼ ὅτι Εἰς αὐτὸ τοῦτο ἐξήγειρά σε, ὅπως ἐνδείξωμαι ἐν σοὶ τὴν δύναμίν μου, καὶ ὅπως διαγγελῇ τὸ ὄνομά μου ἐν πάσῃ τῇ γῇ.

controles.web: For the Scripture says to Pharaoh, “For this very purpose I caused you to be raised up, that I might show in you my power, and that my name might be proclaimed in all the earth.”
controles.kjv: For the scripture saith unto Pharaoh, Even for this same purpose have I raised thee up, that I might shew my power in thee, and that my name might be declared throughout all the earth.
controles.livre: Pois a Escritura diz a Faraó: “Para isto mesmo te levantei: para mostrar em ti o meu poder, e para que o meu nome seja anunciado em toda a terra”.

versos.grego: ἄρα οὖν ὃν θέλει ἐλεεῖ, ὃν δὲ θέλει σκληρύνει.

controles.web: So then, he has mercy on whom he desires, and he hardens whom he desires.
controles.kjv: Therefore hath he mercy on whom he will have mercy, and whom he will he hardeneth.
controles.livre: Portanto, ele tem misericórdia de quem quer, e endurece a quem quer.

versos.grego: Ἐρεῖς μοι οὖν Τί ἔτι μέμφεται; τῷ γὰρ βουλήματι αὐτοῦ τίς ἀνθέστηκεν;

controles.web: You will say then to me, “Why does he still find fault? For who withstands his will?”
controles.kjv: Thou wilt say then unto me, Why doth he yet find fault? For who hath resisted his will?
controles.livre: Tu, então, me dirás: “Por que ele ainda se queixa? Pois quem resiste à sua vontade?”

versos.grego: ὦ ἄνθρωπε, μενοῦνγε σὺ τίς εἶ ὁ ἀνταποκρινόμενος τῷ Θεῷ; μὴ ἐρεῖ τὸ πλάσμα τῷ πλάσαντι Τί με ἐποίησας οὕτως;

controles.web: But indeed, O man, who are you to reply against God? Will the thing formed ask him who formed it, “Why did you make me like this?”
controles.kjv: Nay but, O man, who art thou that repliest against God? Shall the thing formed say to him that formed it, Why hast thou made me thus?
controles.livre: Mas antes, quem és tu, ó, humano, para questionares a Deus? Por acaso a coisa formada dirá ao que a formou: “Por que me fizeste assim?”

versos.grego: ἢ οὐκ ἔχει ἐξουσίαν ὁ κεραμεὺς τοῦ πηλοῦ ἐκ τοῦ αὐτοῦ φυράματος ποιῆσαι ὃ μὲν εἰς τιμὴν σκεῦος, ὃ δὲ εἰς ἀτιμίαν;

controles.web: Or hasn’t the potter a right over the clay, from the same lump to make one part a vessel for honor, and another for dishonor?
controles.kjv: Hath not the potter power over the clay, of the same lump to make one vessel unto honour, and another unto dishonour?
controles.livre: Ou não tem o oleiro poder sobre o barro, para da mesma massa fazer um vaso para honra, e outro para desonra?

versos.grego: εἰ δὲ θέλων ὁ Θεὸς ἐνδείξασθαι τὴν ὀργὴν καὶ γνωρίσαι τὸ δυνατὸν αὐτοῦ ἤνεγκεν ἐν πολλῇ μακροθυμίᾳ σκεύη ὀργῆς κατηρτισμένα εἰς ἀπώλειαν,

controles.web: What if God, willing to show his wrath, and to make his power known, endured with much patience vessels of wrath made for destruction,
controles.kjv: What if God, willing to shew his wrath, and to make his power known, endured with much longsuffering the vessels of wrath fitted to destruction:
controles.livre: E se Deus, querendo mostrar a sua ira, e dar a conhecer o seu poder, suportou com muita paciência os vasos da ira, preparados para a perdição,

versos.grego: καὶ ἵνα γνωρίσῃ τὸν πλοῦτον τῆς δόξης αὐτοῦ ἐπὶ σκεύη ἐλέους, ἃ προητοίμασεν εἰς δόξαν,

controles.web: and that he might make known the riches of his glory on vessels of mercy, which he prepared beforehand for glory,
controles.kjv: And that he might make known the riches of his glory on the vessels of mercy, which he had afore prepared unto glory,
controles.livre: a fim de fazer conhecidas as riquezas da sua glória nos vasos da misericórdia, que preparou com antecedência para a glória,

versos.grego: οὓς καὶ ἐκάλεσεν ἡμᾶς οὐ μόνον ἐξ Ἰουδαίων ἀλλὰ καὶ ἐξ ἐθνῶν;

controles.web: us, whom he also called, not from the Jews only, but also from the Gentiles?
controles.kjv: Even us, whom he hath called, not of the Jews only, but also of the Gentiles?
controles.livre: que somos nós, aos quais ele chamou, não somente dentre os judeus, mas também dentre os gentios?

versos.grego: ὡς καὶ ἐν τῷ Ὡσηὲ λέγει Καλέσω τὸν οὐ λαόν μου λαόν μου καὶ τὴν οὐκ ἠγαπημένην ἠγαπημένην·

controles.web: As he says also in Hosea,  “I will call them ‘my people,’ which were not my people; and her ‘beloved,’ who was not beloved.”
controles.kjv: As he saith also in Osee, I will call them my people, which were not my people; and her beloved, which was not beloved.
controles.livre: Como também diz em Oseias: “Ao que era Não-Meu-Povo, chamarei de Meu-Povo; e a que não era Não-Amada, chamarei de Amada”.

versos.grego: καὶ ἔσται ἐν τῷ τόπῳ οὗ ἐρρέθη αὐτοῖς Οὐ λαός μου ὑμεῖς, ἐκεῖ κληθήσονται υἱοὶ Θεοῦ ζῶντος.

controles.web: “It will be that in the place where it was said to them, ‘You are not my people,’ There they will be called ‘children of the living God.’”
controles.kjv: And it shall come to pass, that in the place where it was said unto them, Ye are not my people; there shall they be called the children of the living God.
controles.livre: E será que, no lugar onde lhes foi dito: “Vós não sois meu povo, Aí serão chamados filhos do Deus vivo”.

versos.grego: Ἡσαΐας δὲ κράζει ὑπὲρ τοῦ Ἰσραήλ Ἐὰν ᾖ ὁ ἀριθμὸς τῶν υἱῶν Ἰσραὴλ ὡς ἡ ἄμμος τῆς θαλάσσης, τὸ ὑπόλειμμα σωθήσεται·

controles.web: Isaiah cries concerning Israel,  “If the number of the children of Israel are as the sand of the sea, it is the remnant who will be saved;
controles.kjv: Esaias also crieth concerning Israel, Though the number of the children of Israel be as the sand of the sea, a remnant shall be saved:
controles.livre: Também Isaías clama acerca de Israel: “Ainda que o número dos filhos de Israel seja como a areia do mar, apenas o remanescente será salvo;

versos.grego: λόγον γὰρ συντελῶν καὶ συντέμνων ποιήσει Κύριος ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς.

controles.web: for He will finish the work and cut it short in righteousness, because the LORD will make a short work upon the earth.”
controles.kjv: For he will finish the work, and cut it short in righteousness: because a short work will the Lord make upon the earth.
controles.livre: porque o Senhor concluirá e executará brevemente a sentença  sobre a terra”.

versos.grego: καὶ καθὼς προείρηκεν Ἡσαΐας Εἰ μὴ Κύριος Σαβαὼθ ἐγκατέλιπεν ἡμῖν σπέρμα, ὡς Σόδομα ἂν ἐγενήθημεν καὶ ὡς Γόμορρα ἂν ὡμοιώθημεν.

controles.web: As Isaiah has said before,  “Unless the Lord of Armies had left us a seed, we would have become like Sodom, and would have been made like Gomorrah.”
controles.kjv: And as Esaias said before, Except the Lord of Sabaoth had left us a seed, we had been as Sodoma, and been made like unto Gomorrha.
controles.livre: E como Isaías predisse: “Se o Senhor dos Exércitos não houvesse nos deixado descendência,  nós nos teríamos tornado como Sodoma, e como Gomorra teríamos sido semelhantes”.

versos.grego: Τί οὖν ἐροῦμεν; ὅτι ἔθνη τὰ μὴ διώκοντα δικαιοσύνην κατέλαβεν δικαιοσύνην, δικαιοσύνην δὲ τὴν ἐκ πίστεως·

controles.web: What shall we say then? That the Gentiles, who didn’t follow after righteousness, attained to righteousness, even the righteousness which is of faith;
controles.kjv: What shall we say then? That the Gentiles, which followed not after righteousness, have attained to righteousness, even the righteousness which is of faith.
controles.livre: Então, que diremos? Que os gentios, que não buscavam a justiça, alcançaram a justiça, mas a justiça que é pela fé;

versos.grego: Ἰσραὴλ δὲ διώκων νόμον δικαιοσύνης εἰς νόμον οὐκ ἔφθασεν.

controles.web: but Israel, following after a law of righteousness, didn’t arrive at the law of righteousness.
controles.kjv: But Israel, which followed after the law of righteousness, hath not attained to the law of righteousness.
controles.livre: porém, Israel, que buscava a Lei da justiça, não alcançou a Lei

versos.grego: διὰ τί; ὅτι οὐκ ἐκ πίστεως ἀλλ’ ὡς ἐξ ἔργων· προσέκοψαν τῷ λίθῳ τοῦ προσκόμματος,

controles.web: Why? Because they didn’t seek it by faith, but as it were by works of the law. They stumbled over the stumbling stone;
controles.kjv: Wherefore? Because they sought it not by faith, but as it were by the works of the law. For they stumbled at that stumblingstone;
controles.livre: Por quê? Porque não a buscavam pela fé, mas sim, como que pelas obras. Tropeçaram na pedra de tropeço,

versos.grego: καθὼς γέγραπται Ἰδοὺ τίθημι ἐν Σιὼν λίθον προσκόμματος καὶ πέτραν σκανδάλου, καὶ ὁ πιστεύων ἐπ’ αὐτῷ οὐ καταισχυνθήσεται.

controles.web: even as it is written,  “Behold, I lay in Zion a stumbling stone and a rock of offense; and no one who believes in him will be disappointed.”
controles.kjv: As it is written, Behold, I lay in Sion a stumblingstone and rock of offence: and whosoever believeth on him shall not be ashamed.
controles.livre: como está escrito: “Eis que ponho em Sião uma pedra de tropeço, e uma rocha de escândalo; e aquele que nela crer não será envergonhado”.
